g.text: So. It's tomorrow. Am I going to get that "how you joined the Hex" conversation now?
can it wait? i'm in the middle of something rn
We're dating, Q. It's obvious you don't want to tell me what happened. You should be able to trust me with things like this.
I've been waiting for you to tell me for a while, and I've been patient.
Just say you don't want to tell me. We all have secrets. Whatever happened, it's your business.
We're friends, Q. It's obvious you don't want to tell me what happened. You should be able to trust me with things like this.
look, i'm gonna give u a pass because it's clear u haven't had many relationships b4 in ur life, IF ANY
fair. fair. yeah. sorry. its not something i like bringing up
Don't keep dragging me along saying you'll tell me, then don't. You don't like being played. Neither do I.
look, i'm gonna give u a pass because it's clear u haven't had many friends b4 in ur life
but being with somebody n trusting them with all the darkest moments of ur life? LMAO. u are such a yute sometimes
but being friends with somebody n trusting them with all the darkest moments of ur life? LMAO. u are such a yute sometimes
I get it. You'll tell me when you're ready, and that's fine. And if "ready" is "never"? That's fine, too.
sol u r cute sometimes. nah. we're not doin' this n i'm not fighting with u. i'm gonna think this over n we'll talk when i've sorted this
even with us being a thing?
... mighty dench of u. all right. well i gotta get this sorted in my head. n when i do? I'll come talk 2 u
For now. I guess. Is it okay with you?
It just might mean we don't get past a certain point. But that's okay with me, if it's okay with you.
I don't know. I'm making this up as I go. I'm not used to relationships. But I want to be with you, and I want you to trust me. But I also know you can't force that.
fair warning, won't be pretty when i do. till then, see u around
dunno. i gotta get this sorted n figure out how i feel. realize now this isn't just something i can drag out
maybe u get this more than i give u credit for. ok. i gotta get this sorted in my head... figure out how i feel
fair warning, won't be pretty when i do. ttys sexy. b/c if u think i'm lettin' u wander off while i get my thoughts in order? u mental
